text: Girls, if you want one bag that gets you through the school run, the coffee run and everything after, this is it. This is the Colette from Velantra, in cashmere feel brushed wool. It's Loro Piana inspired, so the belted front holds it upright instead of slumping. Twenty inches across, and it fits a thirteen inch laptop with room left over. Leather wrapped handles, aged gold hardware, and no logo on it anywhere. Caramel or espresso. They're running a pre-order right now, thirty dollars off before it ships. So go get one, girls, and thank me later.
